categories_archive_state_consistent.name: categories_archive_state_consistent
categories_archive_state_consistent.value: ("categories"."status" = 'active' AND "categories"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("categories"."status" = 'archived' AND "categories"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

financial_accounts_archive_state_consist.name: financial_accounts_archive_state_consistent
financial_accounts_archive_state_consist.value: ("financial_accounts"."status" = 'active' AND "financial_accounts"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("financial_accounts"."status" = 'archived' AND "financial_accounts"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

merchants_merge_state_consistent.name: merchants_merge_state_consistent
merchants_merge_state_consistent.value: ("merchants"."status" = 'merged' AND "merchants"."merged_into_merchant_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("merchants"."status" <> 'merged' AND "merchants"."merged_into_merchant_id" IS NULL)

statements_period_range.name: statements_period_range
statements_period_range.value: "statements"."period_start" IS NULL OR "statements"."period_end" IS NULL OR "statements"."period_start" <= "statements"."period_end"
